sm.$description: Raised. Buttons and resting cards. A whisper of lift, not a drop shadow.

md.$description: Overlay. Dropdowns, popovers, menus. Two soft indigo layers, no pure black.

lg.$description: Floating. Modals, sheets, command palettes. The elevation ceiling. Nothing sits higher.

highlight.$description: Inner top highlight. A 1px lit edge inside a solid control (SJButton). Pairs with shadow.lift; never on a flat surface.

lift.$description: Control lift. A tight indigo-950 shadow under a solid control at rest (SJButton).

glow.$description: Hover glow. shadow.lift plus a 3px soft indigo halo. Deprecated: split into glow.width and opacity.glow so the halo takes each tone's colour; SJButton no longer uses this composite. Kept for consumers; removal is planned for a future major.
glow.$deprecated: Deprecated: split into glow.width and opacity.glow so the halo takes each tone's colour; SJButton no longer uses this composite. Kept for consumers; removal is planned for a future major.

press.$description: Pressed. An inner shadow replacing the lift while a solid control is held down (SJButton).

focus.$description: Focus ring. Pairs with :focus-visible. A two-tone ring, a 2px white gap inside a 2px indigo edge, so one layer always clears 3:1 against the surface behind it, light or brand. Not an elevation level, never decorative.

focus-dark.$description: Focus ring on dark surfaces. A 2px slate 900 gap inside a 2px indigo 400 edge (5.98:1 on slate 900, 6.76:1 on slate 950). Pairs with :focus-visible under a [data-theme='dark'] ancestor.
